reviewItem.question: Does "The `--enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint` cilium-agent flag (`enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint` in Helm) has been deprecated" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint|component=cilium-agent (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: The cilium-agent flag --enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint (Helm enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint) is deprecated, and the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18.
